cluster_recommendation: This batch splits into a healthy always-loaded spatial/GIS trio (blender, qgis, comfyui — all verified against live infra: gui-tools-service sidecar exposes 9876/9877 exactly as documented, comfyui runs in its own healthy Docker container exactly as comfyui_builtin=false implies) and a set of reference-only engine/domain skills of uneven quality. The one must-fix is qgis: three non-cross-referenced MCP server implementations (mcp.json shim, SKILL.md's uv/git-clone entry_point, and the actual live supervisor proxy to gui-tools-service) mean the documented path and the deployed path have diverged, with a stale `supervisorctl status qgis` troubleshooting command as a symptom. lichtfeld-studio silently ignores its own `gaussian_splatting=false` manifest gate, unlike spark-scene which correctly discloses the gate landscape — the two are genuinely complementary (capture/training vs browser presentation) and should stay separate, but lichtfeld-studio needs the gate disclosed. game-dev vs godot-development is a verified factual contradiction (game-dev wrongly claims Godot is natively on PATH; godot-development correctly says it isn't) that could send an agent down a dead command path. terracraft and unreal-engine both under-disclose missing binaries/CLIs their own Quick Starts imply are ready (arnis, terracraft, soft-ue-cli — all absent from PATH, verified live). architecture-studio's 36 nested skills are real and well self-documented internally but invisible to every estate-wide discovery/count tool, and its Claude-Code-native hooks/allowed-tools layer is undisclosed as Claude-only for GPT-6 Astra/Codex consumers. None of these are duplication problems — every cross-skill relationship in this batch (blender/qgis/comfyui triad, lichtfeld-studio/spark-scene, game-dev/godot-development/unreal-engine/meta-xr-sdk, terracraft's integrations) is a correctly-declared handoff, not an overlap.
